name: Earth's Last Year: 1999
source:
[b]What would you do at the end of the world?[/b]

Cedar finds himself asking that question on December 31st, 1999, with the Y2K bug threatening to cause a disaster. With his friends' differing opinions on how to celebrate the upcoming new millennium, Cedar must quickly decide how he wants to celebrate earth's last year.

[From [url=https://mattthegiraffe.itch.io/earths-last-year-1999]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[b]世界末日你会做什么？[/b]

1999年12月31日，当千年虫威胁要引发灾难时，Cedar发现自己问了这个问题。由于朋友们对如何庆祝即将到来的新千年持不同意见，雪松必须迅速决定如何庆祝地球的最后一年。

[来自[url=https://mattthegiraffe.itch.io/earths-last-year-1999]Itch.io[/url]]
